title: अन्धवेग नाटकमा अभिव्यक्त सामाजिक पक्ष {Social Issues Expressed in the Drama Andhabeg}
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेख नाटककार बालकृष्ण समद्वारा लिखित अन्धवेग नाटकको सामाजिक पक्षमा आधारित भएरतयार गरिएको छ । यसमा समको सङ्क्षिप्त परिचय र नाट्य साहित्यमा उनले दिएको योगदानको चर्चा गर्दै नाट्यविधाको परिचय दिएको छ । अन्धवेग नाटकको कथासार प्रस्तुत गरी यसमा अभिव्यक्त सामाजिक पक्षको विश्लेषणगरिएको छ । यसैक्रममा नेपाली समाजको मूल्यमान्यता, धर्म, रीतिरिवाज एवम् परम्परालाई नाघेर वासनामूलकप्रेमले अन्धो बनेका कारण एउटा सुखी र सम्पन्न परिवारको तहसनहस भएको सामाजिक प्रसङ्गका आधारमा कृतिको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । यसका निम्ति नाटकका उपकरणहरुमध्ये विषय, घटना, परिवेश, भाषाशैली आदिका माध्यमबाट सामाजिक पक्ष अभिव्यक्त हुने निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ । साथै यिनै उपकरणका आधारमा अन्धवेगनाटकमा अभिव्यक्त भएको सामाजिक पक्षको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । {This research article has been written based on social issues in the drama, Andhabeg by a well-known Nepali playwright, Balkrishna Sama. The article begins with a brief introduction of the playwright and his contribution to drama as a literary genre. The article analyses the social issues based on the plot of the drama. The drama has been analysed in connection to a well to do family which is ruined due to blind love crossing the border of social norms and values, religious dogmas, customs and conventions. The elements of drama such as subject matter, events, contexts, language etc. are the basis to analyse that the drama basically deals with social issues.}
american_english: This article has been prepared on the basis of the social aspects of the play Andhabeg, written by playwright Balkrishna Sama. It gives a brief introduction of Sama and discusses his contribution to dramatic literature, introducing the dramatic genre. Presenting a summary of the plot of the play Andhabeg, the social aspects expressed in it have been analyzed. In this connection, the work has been analyzed on the basis of the social context in which a happy and prosperous family is ruined because blind love crosses the values, religion, customs and traditions of Nepali society. For this, it has been concluded that the social aspect is expressed through the tools of the play such as subject, event, setting, language style and so on. Also, on the basis of these same tools, the social aspect expressed in the play Andhabeg has been analyzed.

informal_english: This article is built around the social side of Andhabeg, a play by Nepali playwright Balkrishna Sama. It kicks off with a quick intro to Sama and his contribution to drama as a literary form, and gives a rundown of the dramatic genre. It lays out a summary of the play's plot and then digs into the social issues it raises. Along the way it looks at how a once happy, well-off family gets wrecked because blind love blows past Nepali society's values, religion, customs and traditions. It concludes that the social stuff comes through in the play's tools - subject, events, setting, language style and so on. On the basis of those same tools, it also analyzes the social aspects expressed in Andhabeg.
